changed: The author replaced the before/after screenshots in the PR description with a same-size (1861x102) pair taken in the same frame.

Names karlstolley as the reviewer, since he managed this issue and reviewed the earlier #35672 attempt.
Notes that there was no new code push, so the one-commit, +2/-2 display:block CSS change is the same as at the first look.
Flags that the reviewer should check the wrapped-pill and vertical-centering side effects, because the screenshots don't cover that state.
